title: DB's Minecraft REFINED
description: A collection of mostly client-side mods that aim to polish the overall vanilla Minecraft experience.
evidence: DB's Minecraft REFINED is a new modpack created by disrtuptive builds for Minecraft 1.21. It's based on the [DB's Minecraft Plus](https://modrinth.com/modpack/dbs-minecraft-plus) modpack, however all mods that alter the game have been stripped away in favour of mostly client-side only mods (with a few exceptions).
Every single mod and resource pack in this mod pack is aimed to polish the Minecraft experience, enhancing everything from the UI, QOL, sounds, building, structures, biomes and plenty more.
Countless mods improve performance in almost every way possible from world generation and entity culling to memory usage and even the rendering of text in game.
Plenty of mods enhance the UI, adding animations to opening and closing the inventory, moving items, smoothly scrolling inventories and plenty more.
